title: Intake settings extracted from a protocol Methods paragraph (issue #90, design.md 9b/9c)
description: One JSON object per paragraph, keys in exactly this order: frame_interval_h, pixel_um, duration_h, cell_type, assay_type, imaging, proliferation_blocked, condition, in_scope, missing. Serialise with data/adaption/prompt.py canonical(). A value is null when the paragraph does not state it (no guessing, no derivation from instrument names). frame_interval_h and pixel_um feed data/upload.py (--interval, --scale); condition feeds sim/upload.py; in_scope and cell_type/proliferation_blocked drive the scope messages (design 4.4, 5.5).

frame_interval_h.description: time between frames in HOURS, rounded to 4 decimals (20 min -> 0.3333, 90 s -> 0.025). null if not stated.

pixel_um.description: micrometres per pixel of the analysed images, rounded to 4 decimals (650 nm/px -> 0.65). Only if stated as a pixel size / spatial calibration; magnification or a camera/objective name alone -> null.

duration_h.description: total time-lapse duration in HOURS as stated ("for 24 h", "over 2 days" -> 48), rounded to 4 decimals. null if not stated (not derived from frame counts).

cell_type.description: normalised cell name from the vocabulary in data/adaption/prompt.py CELL_TYPES (e.g. MCF10A, MDCK, HaCaT, A549, NIH3T3, HUVEC, keratinocyte, fibroblast, other). Spelling variants map to the canonical name (MCF-10A -> MCF10A, NIH/3T3 -> NIH3T3, HUVECs -> HUVEC). Anything outside the list -> "other". null if not stated.

assay_type.description: scratch = tip/pin/wound-maker scratch of a 2D monolayer; insert = culture-insert / stopper gap (e.g. silicone insert removed); laser = laser ablation wound; other = transwell/Boyden migration, spheroid invasion, organoid or anything else; null if not stated.

imaging.description: imaging modality used to follow closure: phase_contrast; brightfield (bright-field / transmitted light); fluorescence (fluorescence-only, incl. confocal of labelled cells); other (DIC, holographic, ...). If phase contrast or brightfield is used alongside fluorescence, give the transmitted-light one. null if not stated.

proliferation_blocked.description: true if proliferation was blocked (mitomycin C, or serum starvation / serum-free medium during migration); false only if the paragraph explicitly says no inhibitor was used; null if not mentioned.

condition.description: the experimental perturbation studied: "knockdown:GENE" (siRNA / shRNA / CRISPR against GENE, gene symbol upper-case as written, e.g. knockdown:CYR61), "drug:NAME" (compound name only, no dose, e.g. drug:Y-27632), or "control" when only untreated / vehicle / non-targeting controls are described. If a perturbation and its control are both described, give the perturbation. null if not stated.

in_scope.description: true iff the assay is a 2D monolayer gap closure that the tool supports: assay_type is scratch or insert (or null with a monolayer wound described) AND imaging is phase_contrast, brightfield or null. false for laser ablation, transwell, spheroid/3D invasion, in vivo/embryo wounds, or fluorescence-only/other imaging. Validated scope (MCF10A + mitomycin, like WHAD) is checked by code from cell_type and proliferation_blocked, not here.

missing.description: names of the fields above whose value is null, in key order
